risk_note: RV2 ledger + platform queue + app.module (B2-02q; BR-FUND-19). Schedules the daily ledger check: new exclusive worker-only queue ledger-check (concurrency 1), self-rescheduling job daily:<app>:<D> run at D+1 01:00 +08:00 (Clock only, @couli/domain calendar), next day enqueued in a transaction, plus a seed/heal timer in the worker entry. The runner result now carries filedDifferences (file name per difference) handed to the B2-02p execution step. app.module wires, in the worker entry only, payout createWithdrawHolds (with identity's users lock; system audit as an info line, same as B2-07c) as the holds port and content createSystemSwitchWriter as the auto-settlement port. Frozen queue tests changed only to add ledger-check (limits count 42→43 in its own test(spec) commit, D10-415 ①).
